versions.pddl:
(define (problem accountable-drone-mission)
  (:domain accountable-drone)
  (:objects
    drone - drone
    red_package - object
    home current_loc target_loc gate_loc blue_platform - location
    gate_1 - gate
    view_a view_b - viewpoint)
  (:init
    (at drone home)
    (reachable home)
    (reachable current_loc)
    (reachable target_loc)
    (reachable gate_loc)
    (reachable blue_platform)
    (platform blue_platform)
    (gate-at gate_1 gate_loc)
    (gripper-empty drone)
    (object-at red_package target_loc)
    (gate-clear gate_1))
  (:goal (and
    (found red_package)
    (inspected red_package view_a)
    (inspected red_package view_b)
    (traversed gate_1)
    (placed red_package blue_platform)
    (at drone home)
  ))
)
